message.content:
Oxford button-down shirt in crisp white cotton poplin, regular fit with a classic collar, color #FFFFFF, woven cotton. Tailored wool-blend trousers in a charcoal grey herringbone pattern, straight leg cut hitting just above the ankle, color #36454F, 100% virgin wool. Leather loafers with a penny slot, sleek silhouette and flat sole, color #708090, smooth calfskin leather. A thin gold bar necklace adds a touch of subtle refinement without overwhelming the professional setting, color #FFD700, solid 14k gold.

This outfit works perfectly for an autumn workday at 18 degrees Celsius because it adheres to the "neat" dress code while providing appropriate warmth through a wool-blend trouser rather than a heavy coat, which would be unnecessary below +20 °C. The crisp white shirt offers a clean, authoritative look suitable for an office environment, paired with dark grey trousers that maintain professionalism without appearing too rigid. The leather loafers provide comfort for a full day of walking and standing, while the gold necklace introduces a small element of personal style to break up the monochrome palette elegantly.
